input: Shadow a local magistrate for my law studies

gold.taskTitle: Shadow a Local Magistrate for Law Studies
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to arrange and complete a magistrate shadowing experience as part of their law studies.

questions.title: Which stage of your law studies are you currently in?
questions.description: Understand whether the user is an undergraduate, postgraduate, or at another stage of legal education.

questions.title: Is this shadowing required by your institution or self-initiated?
questions.description: Determine whether this is a formal academic requirement with paperwork or a personal initiative.

questions.title: Do you already have a contact at a magistrates court?
questions.description: Find out if the user has an existing connection or needs to find and approach a magistrate from scratch.

questions.title: Which city or region are you based in?
questions.description: Identify the user's location to ensure the plan is relevant to local courts and procedures.

questions.title: How many days or hours of shadowing do you need?
questions.description: Clarify the expected duration or minimum hours required for the experience.

questions.title: Do you have a deadline by which this must be completed?
questions.description: Establish any time pressure, such as an academic submission date or term deadline.

questions.title: What specific area of law are you most focused on?
questions.description: Understand the user's area of interest so the shadowing experience can be targeted appropriately.
